text:
Nina (Design): Quick sync request 15: proposing a compact validation pattern for our console forms. Goal: keep mobile labels tight, avoid duplicate messages, and standardize destructive confirms. Thoughts? Arjun (Product): TL;DR: users want immediate hints but hate repeated noise. Prefer inline for quick fixes, and a single, actionable summary on submit. Also, consistency on required markers is needed. Kai (Eng): Technical: we can dedupe messages by id so summary and inline don't repeat identical text. Inline = validation id: 'email_invalid'. Summary can reference same id then link to field. Zoe (A11y): Accessibility rules: asterisk alone insufficient. Add aria-required to fields and either visible "(required)" text or an offscreen label for SR users. Error summary must be focusable (tabindex="-1") and use role="alert" with aria-live=assertive when shown after submit. Harper (DevEx): Microcopy: prefer direct phrasing: "Please fix 2 issues to save" over softer language. Also for inline messages keep sentences short: "Enter a valid email address." Nina (Design): For interaction, I'm proposing: on blur -> inline validation (aria-live=polite), but do not focus; on submit -> show summary, focus it, then visually mark inline fields. This avoids stealing typing focus. Arjun (Product): For destructive actions: three buckets: low = toast undo, medium = checkbox consent with explicit count, high = typed-confirm. Should we allow paste into typed-confirm? That may make it trivial to bypass. Kai (Eng): Paste is convenient but can reduce safety. We can allow paste but optionally require exactMatch=true for highest-risk actions where case-sensitive exact match is enforced. Also implement cooldown after N failed attempts to prevent brute force (e.g., 3 attempts -> 5s cooldown). Zoe (A11y): Typed-confirm specifics: instructions must be linked with aria-describedby. Ensure screen readers can discover the exact string to type; avoid relying on visual-only emphasis. Also Esc should clear and close. Harper (DevEx): Keyboard flow: cancel should be the first tabbable control so it's easy to escape via keyboard. If toast undo appears, it must be reachable and announced with aria-live=polite. Nina (Design): Copy pattern for typed-confirm: top line "To confirm, type the resource name:" followed by the bold name, then a short warning "This action is permanent." CTA: primary "Delete" (danger), secondary "Cancel". Keep the prompt explicit. Arjun (Product): For medium confirmations, show what will be removed and require a checkbox "I understand this will remove X items". If X > 10, maybe escalate to typed-confirm? Kai (Eng): Implementation note: error summary structure we can reuse across forms: an ordered list with anchor links. Example snippet we can add to docs:
Please fix 3 issues to save
  • Name is required
. Anchors should call focus() on target input and set aria-describedby to inline message. Zoe (A11y): Perfect. Also ensure anchor focus doesn't re-trigger validation announcements that interrupt the SR user; use short pauses or aria-live polite on in-field message updates. Harper (DevEx): Edge-case: when summary is long, don't shove it above the fold on mobile and hide the submit button beneath sticky header. We should offset scroll to leave ~56px of space. infra-bot: FYI: adding analytics events: validation.summary_shown, validation.inline_shown, confirm.typed_attempt to the backlog. Nina (Design): Next steps: I'll upload a compact prototype (desktop + mobile) showing label variants (asterisk + aria-required vs explicit '(required)'). Also include the three confirm patterns. Please comment by Wednesday EOD. Arjun (Product): I'll take copy pass and decide escalation thresholds (count-based). Kai (Eng): I'll draft a short implementation guide and props: allowExactMatch, cooldownMs, summaryFocusBehavior. Zoe (A11y): I'll run quick VoiceOver + NVDA checks on the prototype. Harper (DevEx): I'll prepare a keyboard/a11y checklist for QA. Nina (Design): Thanks all :thumbsup:
